requirements.name: PowerShell 7
requirements.help: The script also runs on Windows PowerShell 5.1, so this is recommended, not required. It additionally needs outbound HTTPS to a Peppol validation web service (the public OpenPeppol/Helger instance by default, or a self-hosted phive-ws).

description: OPTIONAL endpoint setup. The default validator is the public OpenPeppol/Helger service and needs no config. Run this only to validate against a self-hosted phive-ws.
authHelp: Validation endpoint (OPTIONAL — default is the public OpenPeppol/Helger service):
Press Enter at the prompt to keep the public Helger service (nothing is written).
Or enter a URL (e.g. http://localhost:8080/wsdvs) to use a self-hosted phive-ws.
